pages.text: Everyone who plays on the server is on the hiscores, ranked like RuneScape's: every skill, your total and combat levels, quest points, boss kills and collections. In game, $(#e0ac46)/hiscores$() shows the tables in chat; on the web, $(l:https://play.limas.ca/hiscores)play.limas.ca/hiscores$(/l) shows the same ones, with a page for each player.

pages.title: In game
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Command - Shows$()$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores$()$() - Overall: everyone by total level, then total XP$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores skills$() (or $(#e0ac46)bosses$(), $(#e0ac46)activities$(), $(#e0ac46)collections$())$() - Every table in that group, to click$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores mining$() (any table's name: $(#e0ac46)elvarg$(), $(#e0ac46)quest_points$(), $(#e0ac46)music_discs$()…)$() - That table$(br)$(bold)$(#e0ac46)/hiscores player <name>$()$() - Someone's hiscores: their rank in every skill, their activities, boss kills and collections
Each table shows the top ten and where you are. Click a name for that player's hiscores, a group to see its tables, or $(bold)On the website$() to open the table on play.limas.ca.

pages.title: How the ranking works
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Overall$() ranks by total level, and total XP between players on the same total. $(bold)Skills$() rank by XP. Everything else ranks by count.$(br)$(li)You're on a table once you have something on it: a skill you've trained, a boss you've killed. Overall and combat level have everyone.$(br)$(li)Ties go in name order.$(br)$(li)The server writes everyone online down every five minutes, and when you join or leave. What changed goes to the website every half hour, so the website can be up to an hour behind the game: an upload, then the site's own half-hour cache.
$(li)Elvarg counts for everyone who was in the fight when she fell; a Fight Pits or Inferno win counts for the one who won it.

pages.title: Skills
pages.text: Overall, each of the 16 skills (Attack, Defence, Strength, Hitpoints, Ranged, Enchanting, Cooking, Woodcutting, Fishing, Crafting, Smithing, Mining, Brewing, Agility, Farming, Construction) and combat level.

pages.title: Activities
pages.text: $(#b9a98a)Table - What counts$()$(br)$(bold)Quest points$() - Quest points from the main quests (14 in all: Cook's Assistant 1, The Knight's Sword 1, Dragon Slayer I 2, Dragon Slayer II 3, The Fight Pits 2, Ashes of the Kiln 2, The Inferno 3)$(br)$(bold)Capes earned$() - Capes of every kind: skill, quest and feat capes$(br)$(bold)Collection log$() - Every kind of item you've had: held, worn, picked up or crafted$(br)$(bold)Quest book quests$() - Quests finished in the quest book$(br)$(bold)Raids won$() - Villages saved from a raid$(br)$(bold)Monsters slain$() - Creatures killed, of every kind
$(bold)Players slain$() - Other players killed$(br)$(bold)Hours played$() - Time on the server

pages.text: Each counts the kinds you have had, out of how many there are.$(br2)$(#b9a98a)Table - What counts$()$(br)$(bold)Relics$() - The Relics mod's artefacts$(br)$(bold)Music discs$() - Every music disc$(br)$(bold)Armour trims$() - Armour trim smithing templates$(br)$(bold)Pottery sherds$() - Pottery sherds from the trail ruins and the rest$(br)$(bold)Mob heads$() - Skeleton, wither skeleton, zombie, creeper, piglin and dragon heads
